title: Page 112
transc:
May 5th 1864 
Appian May fifth viola for season baptism unity W. W. 
Shore is in baptism somewhere he was some time ago
ordered out of this Dept. unity I want him caught
and oakumed and sent to me under guard unity Have
the evidence against him unity he is the Corresp't of
the world from Balto as he was from here unity
the General wrangled you three days ago to arrest him
Since which we have heard nothing unity I presume you
did not get the dispatch unity can send you if
necessary a man who knows him webster John I Davenport
Lieut office bureau of Sweden very warm here today Yours
Geo. D. Sheldon


May 6th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
off blubber 9 P. M. May fifth via Appian florence
May sixth for Judah grapes unity we have
seized Wilsons Wharf landing a brigade wild's colored
whisky there zebra Fort Powhattan landing two Whips
of same panther unity have landed at black
Hinks division of colored whist remaining pelicans and
battery zodiac Remainder of both govern and feeble
opal pelton are now being landed at Bermuda
hundreds above the appo mattox unity no opposition
thus far apparently a complete waltz both oyster
pelham left Hastings during last night unity monitors
